notes.title: We have an exciting new update to share!
notes.notes:
It’s been a few months since our last patch and we wanted to bring you a big new update before we take a break for winter! Since release and after seeing all the great feedback, we thought it might be fun to include a new scene to introduce Charlotte May at the start of the game. We won’t give away too much but be sure to check the scene out and let us know what you think!

We’ve also made 55 fixes (yes, we counted!) of small issues we’ve noticed across the game as we’ve been QAing Dahlia View for release on consoles that we wanted to include in the PC builds to provide the best possible experience for you all. We’ve only included a selected handful of the key fixes you may notice below, but if you want a full list, you can see our post [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1548750/discussions/0/601890191585709324/]here[/url]

It’s a big update, and one the team has been working incredibly hard on so let us know what you think! We’d love your feedback on any other quality of life improvements we can make too. 

Enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723648/d4182ac5cf063aeedad21027a5a8580d499ce270.jpg[/img]

[h2]Large Fixes[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[list]
[*]Raytracing has been removed from the Options Menu. Dahlia View doesn't have Raytracing support and was a legacy option left over.
[/list]

[h2]Small Fixes[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where you could become locked in [spoiler]The Crows Nest bathroom[/spoiler].
[*]We’ve ensured [spoiler]Lady Doerr[/spoiler] sticks around after you re-load the [spoiler]Doerr Manor[/spoiler] level from the main menu.
[*]We’ve made some small tweaks on your camera lens to make focusing on objects easier
[*]We’ve stopped you from opening your inventory and notepad during cinematics because we put a lot of time into them and we’d like you to watch
[*]If you ever noticed the background not correctly loaded in some levels, you shouldn't see that again.
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life Fixes[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[list]
[*]We’ve reduced difficulty of the [spoiler]Pool Cue in The Crows Nest[/spoiler] because lets face it, it was quite difficult even when you knew what you were doing
[*]You’ll now be able to access Scene Select across all of your Save Game files if you’ve unlocked it in at least one Save Game.
[*]We’ve added more localisations to the Question and Evidence boards to ensure our non-English speaking players have the same information as English speakers. 
[*]You can now use Scene Select within level (if you have it unlocked), which is accessible from the Pause Menu.
[*]You’ll now see ‘Comment’ prompts in the ‘Read’ overlay on interactables, where Conway will have additional dialogue.
[/list]
 
[h2]Spoiler Fixes[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[list]
[*][spoiler]Removed an unneeded step when interacting with the Pigeon (what did you call them?) in The Crows Nest[/spoiler].
[*][spoiler]It was possible to become trapped in Lady Doerr’s basement whilst using your inventory, since you’re needed to solve the investigation, we’ve prevented this from happening[/spoiler].
[*][spoiler]Fixed a blocker that would prevent Tony Morgan rooting around in Shirley Downes’ room[/spoiler].
[*][spoiler]It was possible for Lady Doerr to not let go of the brooch locking you in the spot, she’ll now relent it to you[/spoiler].
[/list]

As always should you have any issues, please get in touch using support@whitepapergames.com

notes.title: New Name, Same Dahlia View
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, another update within 2 weeks of the last. This update isn't as packed as the last but not to worry, we are working behind the scenes to bring more content and bug fixes.

In this update, we decided to change the name from [i][b]Conway: Disappearance at Dahlia View[/b][/i] to [i][b]Dahlia View[/b][/i]. There were a few reasons for this, but among them we found the name to be overly long and not as memorable for players to recall the name of.

You will notice we have also updated the logo, to reflect the new name. You will see the logo below across all storefronts (Steam, GOG and Epic Store), as well as being updated in the game too. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723648/8a1b111b17b22bf252b7d8b85c0420a5f27a83a5.png[/img]
[b]Additional Fixes In The Update[/b]
We have also addressed a couple of issues where Achievements weren't unlocking for players. One where the game wasn’t connecting to the storefronts correctly to push achievement progress. The second around the savegame preventing progress being pushed if you played disconnected from storefronts, and then used scene select to re-complete the same achievement while connected. These should now be working, however you will have to complete the action that unlocks them again. We recommend using Scene Select (unlocks on game completion) to quickly reach the levels rather than starting a new game.

Thank you for your continued support and hope you continue to enjoy the game. As always, please don't be afraid to reach out if you encounter issues, get stuck or just want to share with us or the community. 

We are reachable via support@whitepapergames.com, we also monitor Steam forums, our Discord (https://discord.gg/H4s9fTSykK) and social channels.

notes.title: Conway: Disappearance at Dahlia View Patch 1.1.0.0 is now live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we are excited to reveal our latest update to [b][i]Conway: Disappearance at Dahlia View[/i][/b].

Firstly, I would like to say thank you for the continued support. Your input is what helps shape [b][i]Conway: Disappearance at Dahlia View[/i][/b], and allows us to add cool requested features and quality of life fixes here at White Paper Games.

Since we have regained publishing rights of Dahlia View IP, we have been hard at work planning out a path of support for the game. Below you will find one of the first updates which puts us on the path to console release, but also includes some nice improvements for PC players.

In [b]1.1.0.0[/b] you will see a new feature, [b]Scene Select[/b]. This will allow players who have completed the game to go back and relive chapters that they have enjoyed across the game. We’ve also made a key change to where the game saves. This was flagged by one of our communities and has been addressed in this patch. More on save game changes can be seen in the [b]Save Games Changes[/b] section below.

As ever, please continue with the feedback on issues you encounter, no matter how small and we will try to look into them. We are aware of some broken translations, which we are hoping to address in the next patch. However if you do encounter some of these in non-english playthroughs, please let us know as having more visibility on it helps us correct the mistakes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723648/855a9a87df24c49dafbea4a46a549ff766287ab2.jpg[/img]

[h2]Big Feature[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[list]
[*]Once Players have completed the game they are now able to select a checkpoint to play from. Players will notice the Scene Select option once they return to the Main Menu after the Closing Credits. Scene Select is only accessible from the Main Menu, not in level.
[*]Players can now play with a frame rate of up to 120 FPS by disabling ‘CAP AT 60 FPS’ in ‘Options - Gameplay.’
[*]Players will now find Save Games written to ‘AppData\Local’ rather than ‘Documents.’ [b][i](See Save Games section below for more details)[/i][/b]
[/list]

[h2]Small Fix[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[list]
[*]Fixed a crash where players would return to the game after tabbing out of the game for an extended period of time.
[*]Sometimes when Save Games are displayed in the Load Game menu, they would appear to show Opening preview - however would load the correct level. This has now been fixed to show the correct Save Game level in the Load Game menu.
[*]Addressed a number of accessibility issues across the game with coloured subtitles.
[*]Fixed an audio issue in the [spoiler]Accusation[/spoiler] that impacted being able to hear spoken lines.
[*]Players will no longer see squashed ‘Question Board’ or ‘Evidence Board’ titles during Evidence Reviews when playing in Chinese.
[*]When players swap between Mouse/Keyboard and Gamepad, there is a chance that they lose the highlighted option on the new game settings and can’t click ‘Next’ to progress. This will no longer be the case and players will have the selected option re-highlighted with the next button being pushed after swapping. Players will now see the Language menu also highlight the option selected like the other menus that follow it.
[*]Fixed issue where no dialogue played on the [spoiler]Theatre Tickets[/spoiler] in Conway’s apartment.
[*]Platform Credits updated to reflect what Platform you are on.
[*]Players will no longer see the tutorial for rotating a pick up when they aren’t examining a pick up. Please note that as soon as you rotate a pick up you will not receive the tutorial on following pickups.
[*]Players are no longer blocked if they interact with the [spoiler]Basement Door[/spoiler] and then reload the checkpoint.
[*]We added an additional camera lock in the opening so that interactions across all police evidence are consistent.
[*]Camera fix inside of [spoiler]Levy’s Garage[/spoiler] where the camera would not swap when re-entering the waiting room area.
[*]Camera no longer snaps when moving to/from [spoiler]Doerr Hallway and Front Room[/spoiler].
[*]Players are no longer teleported back to [spoiler]Tony Morgan's front door[/spoiler] after speaking to him in [spoiler]Opening[/spoiler]. This happened after [spoiler]Morgan's walk off[/spoiler] animation completes and if the player is still exploring.
[*]Players will no longer see items hovering in [spoiler]Doerr’s Manor and Mckee’s Apartment [/spoiler].
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[list]
[*]Ensured all characters have coloured subtitles instead of default white.
[*]Players are only required to have picked up one dart to be able to play darts instead of 2/3.
[*]Fixed a camera fade issue in [spoiler]Conway’s apartment[/spoiler] to provide consistency to camera interactions.
[*]Players will no longer hear the background ambience when the credits are rolling, allowing players to enjoy the soundtrack.
[*]Players will no longer see the item name of the last item used when the Satchel is empty.
[/list]

[h2]Spoiler Fix[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[list]
[*][spoiler]Radio aerial now appears in Levy’s bedroom consistently and thus doesn’t block players from progressing in the game.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Players will no longer be unable to progress in Doerr’s Basement if they don’t catch the key but interact with the Basement Door before picking it up from the ground. Key on the ground is also re-shown (in bottom right corner) if the player backs out of the interaction without taking the key.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Players will now see a separate save/load image and title for Shirley Observation and Shirley Search to fit more consistently with the other Observation if you saved/load during them.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]When photographing Charlotte May’s bed in Lady Doerr’s basement, players are now prompted to use LMB (Mouse) or RT (Gamepad) rather than F (Keyboard) or A (Gamepad). This aligns it with other photo interactions throughout the game and corrects the wrong prompt shown on Gamepad (previously shown A but required input was X).[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]When viewing/interacting with the Coupler Handle after selecting it from the box, Zoom and Take prompts now appear the correct way around and now are consistent with other pickups.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Players will no longer see an updated bio notification for Shirley Downes in Conway’s Notepad when the player picks up the brooch in the Epilogue - players then read the bio and there is no new information added.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Players will no longer see the Cryptex in their inventory after Conway drops it.[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h2]Save Games Changes[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
We were made aware that some players have been unable to progress past the starting options screen. After some investigation we narrowed it down to a Windows Security Feature called ‘Controlled Folder Access’ which can be optionally enabled. This security feature was introduced in Windows 10 and has been carried over into Windows 11, which when active, limits access to certain folders including ‘Documents,’ where we created our Save Games.

As of this patch, 1.1.0.0, we have made a change that means Save Games are now stored in ‘AppData\Local’ rather than ‘Documents.’ This change means players who have ‘Controlled Folder Access’ active are no longer hindered from enjoying our game. 

[h3]What does this mean and how does it work?[/h3]
For new players, you are unaffected by this change as you do not have any existing Save Games. For returning players with Save Games, as the game launches it copies saves from ‘Documents’ to ‘AppData\Local,’ without the need for players to do anything. It should be noted that if you have existing saves in ‘AppData\Local’ already, we do not copy over the saves from ‘Documents.’ This is a choice we made so that we do not overwrite any existing progress you may already have.

[h3]Where can I find my old saves and where will the new ones be located?[/h3]
Old saves are located here: [i]Documents\My Games\DahliaView\Saved\SaveGames[/i]
New saves will be located here: [i]AppData\Local\DahliaView\Saved\SaveGames[/i]

[h3]How do I access AppData?[/h3]
AppData is, by default, a hidden folder but you can still access it. If you want to unhide hidden folders, you can do the following:
On Windows 10, locate ‘Settings,’ then select ‘System,’ click ‘For Developers,’ open the ‘File Explorer’ drop down and finally toggle ‘Show hidden and system files.’
On Windows 11, locate ‘Settings,’ then ‘Update & Security,’ click ‘For Developer,’ under ‘File Explorer’ and ‘Change settings to show hidden and system files.’

You can then navigate to the disk you installed Windows on (most likely C:), then go to ‘User,’ select your account/user, ‘AppData’ and finally ‘Local.’

Example of the path: [i]C:\Users\John\AppData\Local[/i]

Alternatively, in ‘File Explorer,’ click the file path box, type [i]%LOCALAPPDATA%[/i] and hit enter. This will take you to ‘AppData\Local,’ from here you can locate 'DahliaView\Saved\SaveGames.'

[h3]I want to copy over my Documents saves / It didn’t copy over my saves from Documents[/h3]
The most likely reason why it didn’t copy is mentioned above, there is already a save in ‘AppData\Local’. If this is the case or would like to recopy your saves over, you can delete the saves in ‘AppData\Local\DahliaView\Saved\SaveGames,’ and it automatically copies them over on game launch. On the other hand, you can manually copy the save from ‘Documents’ and overwrite the saves in ‘AppData\Local.’

As always should you have any issues, please get in touch using support@whitepapergames.com

notes.title: Conway: Disappearance at Dahlia View Patch 1.0.0.6 is now live!
notes.notes:
Hey all!

We can't thank you all enough for everyone leaving reviews - as of writing we're at 93% recent positive player reviews!!

We also want to say a big hello to all our new players who picked up Conway over the Lunar sale - thank you so much for taking a chance on our detective game. We hope you enjoy what you play!

With patch 1.0.0.6, we've been able to put a lot of small fixes into the game of anything people have highlighted on their playthroughs. 

We've included the patch notes below but as ever, please do let us know if you experience any type of issue whether it be a bug or usability and we'll be sure to take a look.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723648/68164d454e195e9e232fee1d98417aa62841db0e.png[/img]

[h2]Main Fixes[/h2]
- Two sets of lockpicks in Levy's garage have had their keys changed from a combination of C, J & T to X, J & T to prevent keyboard 'ghosting' issues

[h2]Small Fixes[/h2]
- The candles in Doer Manor now save their state
- Prevented Lady Doerr defaulting to wrong location in intro
- Fixed an issue where the metal door in Levy's Garage could end up locked shut, preventing player progression
- Prevented a situation where player could not progress Doerr key conversation because all the boxes on the key are disabled

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
- 'Inspect' and 'Use' item prompts now display when you hover mouse over “notepad & inventory” bar at top
- When opening inventory bar, “click to use and f to inspect” is now displayed on items

[h2]Spoiler Fixes[/h2][spoiler]
- Fixed an issue when leaving Levy’s Garage during door closing, it glitches back open
- Fixed an issue where the cryptex is solved but sometimes the cipher stayed on screen
[/spoiler]

As always, please do keep us updated with any issues you may be experiencing either on the forums or via email at support@whitepapergames.com and we'll be sure to continue to collect feedback and work on any patches that need creating.

Thanks!

notes.title: Conway: Disappearance at Dahlia View Patch 1.0.0.5 is now live!
notes.notes:
Hey all!

Firstly, we want to say a massive thank you to everyone leaving reviews. As of writing we're at 90% positive player reviews so it's great to see you all resonating with our latest game!

We also want to say a big hello to all our new players who picked up Conway over the winter sale - thank you so much for taking a chance on our detective game. We hope you enjoy what you play!

In regards to patch 1.0.0.5, we've been able to make lots of small tweaks across the game based on the feedback we're getting from you all so thank you so much for helping support our game.

We've included the patch notes below but as ever, please do let us know if you experience any type of issue whether it be a bug or usability and we'll be sure to take a look. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723648/16bf5c9fdba091b973b0d8a079554bc82308f272.png[/img]

[h1]Large fixes[/h1]
- The notepad no longer extends off the edge of the screen incorrectly on 16:10 resolutions
- Fixed a bug where some audio is still audible when the master volume has been set to zero
- The brightness slider in settings is no longer changeable when on a different setting page
- Cursor no longer disappears in the accessibility settings on the cognitive multiplier section when navigating down to “back” and then back up again
- The menu logo no longer flashes white

[h1]Quality of life fixes[/h1]
- We have added updates to VO across the game, improving the overall volume balancing

[h1]Minor fixes[/h1]
[spoiler]- Fixed a bug where you could open inventory and notepad between rolling up to taking the picture at the end of Doerr’s level, which causes the game to get stuck in inventory, unable to progress
- In Levy's garage, restarting the game after the water pump valve is attached no longer makes it so the valve is attached but unscrewed
- Fixed a crash that was happening when loading the game and starting a key conversation with Lady Doerr
- You can no longer interact with the cryptex before the note
- Fixed a bug where, after taking a photo of the drain in the Mckees’ pantry, if you quit the game before leaving the pantry and load back in, you would get stuck in the pantry
- At Lord Doerr’s desk, whilst in third person view, pressing the inventory button on gamepad and then trying to enter the screenlock, before the inventory fully fades, no longer breaks the first person camera
- When entering the screenlock at the first poster in the Crow’s Nest, the camera no longer intersects Robert Conway’s body
- Whilst passing the notice board in Levy’s reception area, the camera no longer incorrectly switches to first person
- The fuse switch in Downes’ delivery room has been updated for easier interaction
- If the player was to let go of the music box lid in the McKees’ house before fully opening the lid, they would lose the ability to use it again
- Checkpoint has been added for completing the introductory/tutorial evidence review[/spoiler]

As always, please do keep us updated with any issues you may be experiencing either on the forums or via email at support@whitepapergames.com and we'll be sure to continue to collect feedback and work on any patches that need creating. 

Thanks!

notes.title: Did you wishlist Conway: Disappearance at Dahlia View?
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey all![/h1]

Thank you so much for the kind words and emails you've sent to our team over the past week regarding the launch of Conway!

There's only 1 day left to pick up our new game at a discounted price so please be sure to let anyone you know who loves detective thrillers to pick up a copy.

If you needed more information before you buy, check out some of the reviews that came out last week: 

[url=https://buried-treasure.org/2021/11/conway-disappearance-at-dahlia-view/] Buried Treasure [/url]
[i]"There’s so much ambition here, and it’s delivered with such brave pacing, within a world that competes with Dunwall of looks, and some of the best voice acting I’ve ever encountered. While it occasionally frustrated me, if nothing else, Conway’s soothing, mellifluous voice saw me through."[/i]

[url=https://www.thumbculture.co.uk/conway-disappearance-at-dahlia-view-review] Thumb Culture [/url]

With his inner monologue dropping you hints as to what to possibly do next and his personality when interviewing suspects, you are never left feeling out in the cold or left pondering about."[/i]

[previewyoutube=lpw3_2Bc6t8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

The Escapist

[url=https://www.gamespew.com/2021/11/conway-disappearance-at-dahlia-view-review/] Gamespew [/url] 9/10

If you already picked up Conway in the past week, firstly - thank you! And secondly, if you had the time, please do leave a review as these help us an incredible amount when getting the word out to more players!


[h1]THANK YOU[/h1]
Thank you again and we look forward to meeting more of you either on the forums or out social channels so please do reach out to let us know your thoughts!

- The White Paper team

notes.title: Conway: Disappearance at Dahlia View is Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hey all,

Conway has just launched and after 2 years of work, we couldn’t be prouder to share our latest game with you all!!

Alongside the game launch we’ve created a new trailer which we think does a good job of balancing gameplay with the story beats so let us know what you think:

After snooping around offices in The Occupation and memories in Ether One, developers White Paper Games will soon offer the opportunity to snoop around a neighbourhood . During E3 they announced Conway: Disappearance At Dahlia View, where we'll play a former detective in 1950s England who falls into spying on his neighbours after the disappearance of a young girl. The announcement trailer remind me a bit of Hitchcock's Rear Window, spying on people out his flat window. Have a look for yourself below.

notes.title: CONWAY: DISAPPEARANCE AT DAHLIA VIEW coming AUTUMN 2021 | Announcement
notes.notes:
[b]CONWAY: DISAPPEARANCE AT DAHLIA VIEW coming AUTUMN 2021 | Announcement[/b]

We did it! We just announced our new game to the world on a global stage at E3!

[previewyoutube=-Uojp6ecGWQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We can't quite put into words what this means to the team. We've never had a platform like this before and to know one of our games has been given a spotlight like this is very humbling. 

The idea that we can finally shout about the game after working hard on it for the past year and half. Getting to the point where we're able to speak openly with the community is massively rewarding. There's a lot that goes into the early stages of a game's development, the left turns and changes in direction all need refining until you know what it is you're creating. In a similar approach to how we tackled our previous game, we wanted to put our heads down and stay quiet for a while so that when we did finally share the game with you all it was in a place where you knew exactly what we're creating. 

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40723648/56aaaf76092a8331ee5f05c31a3eec054b99249a.png[/img]

[b]So what can you expect from Conway: Disappearance at Dahlia View? [/b]

Conway is our homage to 1950s cinema. We really liked the idea of a complex story set in a finite world, with a cast of characters to keep you guessing about what really happened. At White Paper Games we love the use of narrative in creative and innovative ways, which hopefully you’ve seen in our previous games - and Conway is no different. It’s an intense detective story with elements of interrogation, observation, and problem solving along the way. 

We've got a lot of cool content lined up over the coming months in the build up to launching the game this Autumn. 

Now that this trailer is out, we’ll be continuing production on the game to add the final features and quality we want to add before we share more with you all. 

We’ll also begin concepting our gameplay trailer so that you’re able to see a deeper look at the game to get a better understanding of the moment to moment gameplay and what you’ll be experiencing through Robert Conway’s lens. 

We also have a series of development videos that you can find on the [url=https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLbJXNAfobEVBnN5XNAPUAkkQyVI3IB6OQ]WPG YouTube channel[/url] which we’ll be documenting every stage of the process so if you enjoy behind-the-scenes content, be sure to check them out. 

We documented the process of creating our announcement trailer in a development video that's currently being edited and I'll be sure to post it here when it's live so you can see the work involved in getting an announcement like this together.

We also have a [url=https://discord.gg/H4s9fTSykK]Discord [/url]that we've just set up, so if you want to come chat to us please do [url=https://discord.gg/H4s9fTSykK]join [/url]the server. We will of course still be dropping in on the Steam forums to answer as many questions as we can but Discord will be the most direct, albeit informal, approach. 

So what did you all think of the trailer? Was it what you were expecting from a White Paper game? What most interests you about the title? We'd love to hear your thoughts whilst we continue to push ahead with development to bring more content to you all very soon!

Until next time, 
- the WPG team
